title: An Empirical Study of LLM-as-a-Judge: How Design Choices Impact Evaluation Reliability

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the scoring consistency and alignment with human judgments of LLM evaluators under different prompt designs (presence/absence of reference answers and score rubrics), decoding strategies, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) usage, evaluated via correlation coefficients and Krippendorff's alpha.
Using the EvalBiasBench benchmark to test whether evaluator LLMs can effectively and consistently penalize socially biased responses when provided with explicit evaluation criteria.
